title: Evaluate
source:
pred = [model["predict"](x) for x in X_test]
tp = sum(1 for p, t in zip(pred, y_test) if p == 1 and t == 1)
tn = sum(1 for p, t in zip(pred, y_test) if p == 0 and t == 0)
fp = sum(1 for p, t in zip(pred, y_test) if p == 1 and t == 0)
fn = sum(1 for p, t in zip(pred, y_test) if p == 0 and t == 1)
precision = tp / (tp + fp) if tp + fp else 0.0
recall = tp / (tp + fn) if tp + fn else 0.0
metrics = {"accuracy": (tp + tn) / len(y_test), "precision": precision, "recall": recall,
           "f1": 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if precision + recall else 0.0,
           "confusion": {"tp": tp, "tn": tn, "fp": fp, "fn": fn}}
print({k: (round(v, 3) if isinstance(v, float) else v) for k, v in metrics.items()})
description: Accuracy, precision, recall and F1 on the held-out set. Defines `metrics`.
